## ResolveReferenceRequest interface

The body of `POST /references/v1/resolve`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ResolveReferenceRequest
```

## Remarks

The body has exactly these fields; a request with any other field is refused with `VALIDATION_FAILED`<!-- -->.

`reference` is the reference control record exactly as encoding a reference produces it (`{"reference": {…}}`<!-- -->, phases/13 D7), validated by the runtime against the app contract's resource table.
